visual_review.scope: Five final-commit screenshots manually inspected: Ubuntu 24.04 valid PM fixture, non-finite PM fixture and installed release startup; EL8 valid and non-finite PM fixtures. Other archived screenshots were not manually inspected.
observations: Scaled clock heading is fully visible on the initial empty 1100-pixel-wide release window after the fix.
The 1300-pixel-wide fixtures show all 24 fields, units, raw words, offsets and separate clock correction without clipped status text.
The non-finite FCLK is Unavailable with raw 0x7f800001 while UCLK and other valid values remain visible.
Release startup is empty, Copy JSON is disabled, and no automatic PM read is reported.
Minimal CI fonts lack Chinese filename glyphs; the filename has missing-glyph boxes, while Unicode path import and JSON roundtrip tests pass. This is not a Chinese-font deployment test.

visual_fix.reason: First screenshot showed the scaled-clock heading clipped before loading data. Final source sizes empty-table columns and asserts sufficient heading width.

remaining_evidence_review.inference: The candidate driver does not resolve the documented physical-target and native PM transfer gaps; a clear issue list is not feature parity.

limits: Only the eight exact table versions and 24 public fields; no complete PM map or physical-core identity
Read requires an already installed compatible ryzen_smu sysfs driver; no native OCTool PM transport, autoload or installer
PM reads may trigger firmware transfer through the external driver; atomicity and freshness not guaranteed
BCLK correction is based on an explicitly supplied value, not a BCLK measurement
No physical tuning/stability/Secure Boot acceptance; other AMD, Intel and board controls remain pending
Portable core validation on Windows/macOS is not a full hardware port
